title: Mixing: Mull Of Kintyre, Girls School by Wings | 1977
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

The final mixing session for Wings’ single ‘Mull Of Kintyre’/‘Girls School’ took place at Abbey Road on 5 October 1977.

The recording had been completed on 3 October, and the next day two tape reels were filled with mixes of both songs, but Paul McCartney remained unhappy with the results. The final mixes were made on this day, and the song was finally ready to be mastered.
